run: meta-loop: RQGM loop improves its own design + token efficiency, grounded in recent RSI research

pairwise_criteria.test: rules are internally consistent and executable by an agent host (no undefined terms, no deadlocks, clear state transitions)
maker-checker, substrate firewall, human checkpoint at escalation, G1-G6, held-out sealing, rubric-echo screening are preserved or strengthened (a 'worse' here vetoes a variant)
the loop as specified spends fewer agent calls / context tokens per iteration for the same decision quality (diff-only context, model tiering, pairwise/early-exit judging, caching)
acceptance decisions are robust to LLM-judge noise and cannot stall while real per-criterion progress is made
new mechanisms are grounded in verified recent RSI research, cited faithfully, adaptations labeled

accept_rule: variant passes the leakage screen, majority of pairwise judges prefer it over the current baseline, no judge rates d2 worse, word caps hold
stop: 20 epochs, or 3 consecutive epochs with no accepted variant (HALT STALL), or proposer reports convergence; then held-out pairwise check final vs v10
